title: UoW Manifest Schema
description: Schema for Unit of Work manifests. Stored at out/{context}/{module}/{component}_{tool}/uow.manifest.json. Supports build, test, lint, and scan contexts with unified structure.

tool.description: Tool/handler name (e.g., go, gotest, trivy-vuln, go-lint). May be empty for some contexts.

exit_code.description: Exit code of tool execution (0 = success, >0 = failure, -1 = cached)

input_hash.description: Hash of inputs. Empty for NoOp UoWs.

artifacts.description: Output artifacts. Empty for NoOp UoWs and non-artifact-producing contexts (lint, some tests).

output_hash.description: Hash of all artifact hashes. Empty for NoOp UoWs.

noop.description: True if UoW intentionally produces no output. Cache detection treats NoOp UoWs as always up-to-date if exit_code is 0. Used for placeholder UoWs like modules with no buildable components, no tests, no lintable code, or non-scannable components.

metadata.description: Context-specific key-value pairs. For NoOp UoWs, typically contains 'reason' key.
